modalities.evidence: task-based fMRI datasets and one resting-state fMRI dataset
performing time-constrained precision reaches to spatial targets

output.population: 68 participants, ages 18–26; this version contains raw data from healthy controls only
output.summary: Task-based functional MRI of an incentivized reaching task comparing standard and high-incentive trials with reward or loss outcomes, part of a movement and incentivization resource aimed at Parkinson's disease.
